reconstruction.test_sources: git checkout the recorded test revision and copy the recorded directed test source as performed by the shared evaluator

port_test.configuration: Uses AXI and HPDcache packages and type macros from the recorded revisions, with 64-bit data, address and user signals and 4-bit transaction IDs from the selected CVA6 configuration.
port_test.comparison: 233 checks at the ports cover independent ready/valid handshakes, ordinary and atomic AW attributes, data and last markers while AW is blocked, and B response ID, error and exclusive status independently of the current AW.
port_test.environment: Requires Verilator with --binary, --timing and --assert, a C++ compiler, make, and a CVA6 checkout with the pinned CVA6 and HPDcache objects.
port_test.result: The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch are FAIL (1). Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID (2). The architectural test runs after the port test passes.
